label: 0–60 elapsed time
description_child: How many seconds it takes to change from 0 to 60 miles per hour.
description_parent: An elapsed-time measurement over a fixed velocity change; it is not itself acceleration.

label: Average acceleration
description_child: How quickly velocity changes over a stretch of time.
description_parent: Change in velocity divided by elapsed time; a 0–60 time supports average acceleration over that interval, not instantaneous acceleration.
